verdict.rationale: Sentry's web API is documented as able to "manage and export data", and a free self-hosted edition gives users an exit path. Community users explicitly describe self-hosting as an escape hatch from vendor lock-in. However, nothing shows a complete bulk export in documented open formats. The only relocation tooling cited moves data from self-hosted into SaaS, not out of it. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, a specified open export format (e.g., JSON/CSV/OTLP egress), outbound migration/relocation tooling, and hands-on corroboration of a completed exit.
